Job J-2207 is not released. Submitted QC: 0 of 3 panels passed.

2207-1 failed on bare areas and low DFT. 2207-2 and 2207-3 failed on runs plus low DFT. Runs cannot be repaired in this booth, so those two panels cannot be recovered here.

I cleaned the gun first (night shift had left it dirty), then mapped build on the test card and on small patches. At the best allowed standoff (100 mm), transfer was only about 17% and did not improve with flow or speed; a larger standoff was worse. At 50% solids, 400 ml cannot build 60 µm on all three 600×400 mm panels at that transfer — the ceiling is about 48 µm average even with no waste. Heavier trial sprays also crossed the sag threshold and left runs on 2207-2 and 2207-3.

Do not clear unattended running of SB-2 on this result. Before the next attempt, check gun atomization/transfer and whether the pot volume matches CS-J-2207 (60–90 µm). Do not ship J-2207.
